project.name: Tideway Apartments cladding remediation, 27 Tideway Crescent
project.summary: The owners corporation of Tideway Apartments, a fully occupied 8-storey, 56-apartment Class 2 strata building in Meadowbank constructed in 2011, must remove PE-core ACP and an EPS render system under a council fire safety order. Funded by special levies, it appoints a project manager and consultant team, lodges a DA for the change of appearance and will let one AS 4000 lump sum contract for a ventilated rainscreen of solid aluminium panels, worked from a perimeter scaffold over the council footpath.

lots: Strata Plan 87654 (Lots 1 to 56 and common property)
